user.title: The unit
user.description: The entities of the ventilation integration this controller reads and drives. Discovered where possible, so this is normally a matter of confirming it. Rooms found on the unit: {rooms}.

data_description.operation_mode_select: Only read, never written. The decisions assume the unit is in manual mode, and a repair is raised when it is not.
data_description.compressor_sensor: Used to decide whether a release may be changed: while the compressor is standing still it may change freely.
data_description.forecast_entity: Optional. Lets a cold morning under a warm forecast skip the heat pump.
data_description.pv_sensor: Optional. Raises setpoints while a surplus is available.
data_description.notify_service: Optional, for example notify.mobile_app_phone. Messages are gathered for five minutes.
data_description.dry_run: Everything is decided and published, nothing is written. On for a fresh install.
data_description.supply_temperature_sensor: Optional. With the extract air and the outdoor reading, this is what says whether the bypass is moving any air at all.
data_description.extract_temperature_sensor: Optional. The air leaving the house, which is what there is to recover from.
data_description.bypass_sensor: Optional, and read only. There is no write register for the damper on any known firmware.
data_description.add_rooms: Creates one room per thermostat of the unit, with the name it already has. Contacts, humidity and CO₂ belong to other integrations and are added per room afterwards.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Already set up. One controller drives one unit.

error.already_controlled: Another room already drives this thermostat. Two rooms on one thermostat would write the same setpoint from two decisions.

operation_mode.title: The unit is not in manual mode
operation_mode.description: The operating mode reads {mode}. This controller sets the fan level, the releases and every setpoint itself, and the unit's own seasonal programme works against that. Set the operating mode back to manual.

input_unavailable.title: An input cannot be read
input_unavailable.description: These were configured and have not reported for a while: {inputs}. Each one falls back to a documented safe value, which the decision sensors name, but the decision is poorer for it.

stuck_write.title: A value is not being accepted
stuck_write.description: These were written repeatedly and still do not read back: {writes}. The write is retried on every evaluation, so this is the device or the connection rather than the controller.
